api_function: Retrieve a collection of YouTube search results (videos, channels, and playlists by default) that match the supplied query parameters. The response includes snippet metadata for each result and supports ordering and pagination.
parameters_constraints: part is required and must be the string value 'snippet'. maxResults is an integer between 0 and 50 inclusive (default 5). order is a string and must be one of: date, rating, relevance, title, videoCount, viewCount (default 'relevance'). channelId is a string identifying a YouTube channel. channelType is a string and must be one of: any, show. eventType is a string and must be one of: completed, live, upcoming. forContentOwner, forDeveloper, and forMine are boolean flags (true/false). location is a string representing geographic coordinates in decimal degrees as latitude,longitude (e.g., 37.42307,-122.08427) with no extra characters or spaces. locationRadius is a string consisting of a positive floating-point number immediately followed by a unit (m, km, ft, or mi); values greater than 1000 km are not supported. onBehalfOfContentOwner is a string identifier for a content owner. pageToken is a string page token returned by a prior response. publishedAfter and publishedBefore are strings formatted as RFC 3339 date-time values in UTC (e.g., 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z). q is a free-text string; it may include the Boolean NOT (-) and OR (|) operators, and the pipe character must be URL-escaped as %7C. regionCode is a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (typically uppercase letters). relatedToVideoId is a string YouTube video ID. relevanceLanguage is typically an ISO 639-1 two-letter language code, or 'zh-Hans'/'zh-Hant' for Simplified/Traditional Chinese. safeSearch is a string and must be one of: moderate, none, strict. topicId is a string identifying a Freebase topic. type is a string that should be a comma-separated list of resource types, with the default 'video,channel,playlist' (values should be from video, channel, playlist). videoCaption is a string and must be one of: any, closedCaption, none. videoCategoryId is a category ID string. videoDefinition is a string and must be one of: any, high, standard. videoDimension is a string and must be one of: 2d, 3d, any. videoDuration is a string and must be one of: any, long, medium, short. videoEmbeddable is a string and must be one of: any, true. videoLicense is a string and must be one of: any, creativeCommon, youtube. videoSyndicated is a string and must be one of: any, true. videoType is a string and must be one of: any, episode, movie.
